fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have a date of issue less than 10 years before the date you arrive.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de emisión de menos de 10 años antes de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: At Spanish border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo español puede que tengas que mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote:
At Spanish border control, you may need to show:

- a return or onward ticket

entry.en: At the border you may also need to show proof of travel insurance and of having enough money for your stay.
entry.es: En la frontera también puede que debas mostrar un seguro de viaje y prueba de tener dinero suficiente para tu estancia.
entry.quote:
- proof of your travel insurance

- you have enough money for your stay

entry.en: Under the EU Entry/Exit System you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo when entering the Schengen area for short stays.
entry.es: Con el Sistema de Entrada/Salida de la UE puede que debas registrar datos biométricos, como huellas y foto, al entrar en Schengen para estancias cortas.
entry.quote: you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more.
entry.es: Debes declarar el efectivo o los cheques de viaje por valor de 10.000 euros o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries, with some exceptions such as powdered baby milk and baby food.
entry.es: No se puede entrar en países de la UE con carne, leche ni productos que los contengan, con excepciones como la leche en polvo para bebés y la comida infantil.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

safety.en: Street crime is a risk: thieves use distraction techniques and often work in teams.
safety.es: El robo en la calle es un riesgo: los ladrones usan técnicas de distracción y a menudo trabajan en equipo.
safety.quote: Thieves use distraction techniques and often work in teams.

safety.en: Thieves posing as police officers may ask to see your wallet; genuine officers will ask for ID but not for wallets or purses.
safety.es: Ladrones que se hacen pasar por policías pueden pedirte la cartera; los policías auténticos piden identificación pero no carteras ni monederos.
safety.quote: Thieves posing as police officers may ask to see your wallet, claiming they need to see it for identification.

safety.en: Large cities such as Alicante, Barcelona, Madrid and Sevilla report many incidents of pick-pocketing, mugging and violent attacks.
safety.es: Ciudades grandes como Alicante, Barcelona, Madrid y Sevilla registran muchos casos de carterismo, atracos y agresiones violentas.
safety.quote: Large cities like Alicante, Barcelona, Madrid, and Sevilla, in particular, report many incidents of pick-pocketing, mugging, and violent attacks

safety.en: 'Highway pirates' target foreign-registered and hire cars, especially those towing caravans.
safety.es: Los 'piratas de carretera' atacan coches extranjeros y de alquiler, sobre todo los que remolcan caravanas.
safety.quote: ‘Highway pirates’ target foreign-registered and hire cars, especially those towing caravans.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Spain, and attacks could be indiscriminate, including in places visited by foreign nationals.
safety.es: Es probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en España, que podrían ser indiscriminados, incluso en lugares visitados por extranjeros.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try and carry out attacks in Spain.

safety.en: It is illegal to drink alcohol in the street in some areas of Spain, and you can get an on-the-spot fine.
safety.es: En algunas zonas de España es ilegal beber alcohol en la calle y puedes recibir una multa en el acto.
safety.quote: It’s illegal to drink alcohol in the street in some areas of Spain. You can get an on-the-spot fine.

health.en: The tap water in Spain is safe and of drinkable quality.
health.es: El agua del grifo en España es segura y de calidad potable.
health.quote: The tap water in Spain is safe and of a drinkable quality.

health.en: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Spain you need a GHIC or EHIC, which is not an alternative to travel insurance.
health.es: Para recibir atención sanitaria pública médicamente necesaria en España hace falta una GHIC o EHIC, que no sustituye al seguro de viaje.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Spain, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: Healthcare facilities must treat you if you are injured or seriously ill, even if you are uninsured, and you pay for the service later.
health.es: Los centros sanitarios deben atenderte si estás herido o gravemente enfermo, aunque no tengas seguro, y pagas el servicio después.
health.quote: it would be illegal for them not to treat you, even if you are uninsured.

health.en: Medicines are sold only at pharmacies (farmacias), marked with a green cross, and nearly every city and town has at least one 24-hour pharmacy.
health.es: Los medicamentos se venden solo en farmacias, señaladas con una cruz verde, y casi todas las ciudades tienen al menos una farmacia de 24 horas.
health.quote: Pharmaceuticals are not sold at supermarkets, only at farmacias (pharmacies/chemists), identified with a green cross

health.en: Dengue and biting insects and ticks are listed among the health risks in Spain.
health.es: El dengue y los insectos y garrapatas que pican figuran entre los riesgos para la salud en España.
health.quote:
See what health risks you’ll face in Spain, including:

- dengue

- biting insects and ticks

help.en: The emergency number in Spain is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en España es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: Some Spanish cities offer a Foreign Tourist Assistance Service (SATE) where you can report crimes in English.
help.es: Algunas ciudades españolas ofrecen un Servicio de Atención al Turista Extranjero (SATE) donde se pueden denunciar delitos en inglés.
help.quote: Some Spanish cities also offer a Foreign Tourist Assistance Service (‘Servicio de Atención al Turista Extranjero’ or ‘SATE’) where you can report crimes in English.

help.en: Violent crime or sexual assault must be reported in person at the nearest police station.
help.es: Un delito violento o una agresión sexual deben denunciarse en persona en la comisaría más cercana.
help.quote: If you want to report a violent crime or sexual assault, you must go in person to the nearest police station.

help.en: You can make a police report by phone in English on +34 901 102 112, available 09:00-21:00 seven days a week.
help.es: Puedes denunciar por teléfono en inglés en el +34 901 102 112, de 09:00 a 21:00 todos los días.
help.quote: You can make a police report by phone in English ☏ +34 901 102 112. The English language service is available 09:00-21:00, seven days a week.

getting_in.en: The busiest airports are Madrid-Barajas, Barcelona El Prat, Palma de Mallorca and Malaga.
getting_in.es: Los aeropuertos más concurridos son Madrid-Barajas, Barcelona El Prat, Palma de Mallorca y Málaga.
getting_in.quote: The busiest airports are Madrid–Barajas Airport, Barcelona El Prat, Palma de Mallorca and Malaga

getting_in.en: For mainland Spain, Madrid (MAD), Barcelona (BCN) and Malaga (AGP) are the most likely ports of entry.
getting_in.es: Para la España peninsular, Madrid (MAD), Barcelona (BCN) y Málaga (AGP) son los puntos de entrada más probables.
getting_in.quote: For mainland Spain, Madrid Barajas (MAD IATA), Barcelona (BCN IATA) and Malaga (AGP IATA) are your most likely ports of entry

getting_in.en: Spain's flag carrier is Iberia, and its two other main airlines are Vueling and Air Europa.
getting_in.es: La aerolínea de bandera de España es Iberia, y sus otras dos aerolíneas principales son Vueling y Air Europa.
getting_in.quote: Spain's flag carrier is Iberia, and its two other main airlines are Vueling and Air Europa.

getting_in.en: Trains between Barcelona and France are operated jointly by SNCF and Renfe, which both sell tickets for any international train on that route.
getting_in.es: Los trenes entre Barcelona y Francia los operan conjuntamente SNCF y Renfe, que venden billetes de cualquier tren internacional de esa ruta.
getting_in.quote: Trains between Barcelona and France are operated jointly by SNCF and renfe and both sell tickets for any international train on that route.

getting_in.en: Regular ferries run from mainland Spain to the Balearic Islands (3-7h) and the Canary Islands (36-40h).
getting_in.es: Hay ferris regulares desde la España peninsular a las Baleares (3-7 h) y a Canarias (36-40 h).
getting_in.quote: Regular ferries travel from mainland Spain to the Balearic Islands (3-7h) and Canary Islands (36-40h).

getting_around.en: Long-distance train tickets need to be bought in advance, and prices can change over time like airlines' (dynamic pricing).
getting_around.es: Los billetes de tren de larga distancia hay que comprarlos con antelación y sus precios pueden cambiar como los de las aerolíneas.
getting_around.quote: Long-distance train tickets need to be purchased in advance, and their prices might change over time like airlines' (dynamic pricing).

getting_around.en: Spain has the second longest high-speed network in the world.
getting_around.es: España tiene la segunda red de alta velocidad más larga del mundo.
getting_around.quote: Spain has the second longest high-speed network in the world, so always consider trains.

getting_around.en: There are no services in Spain where you can buy tickets onboard, and you have to tap on in all of them.
getting_around.es: En España no hay servicios donde se puedan comprar billetes a bordo, y en todos hay que validar al entrar.
getting_around.quote: There are no services in Spain where you can buy tickets onboard, and you have to tap on in all of them.

getting_around.en: The least expensive way to get around most parts of Spain is by bus.
getting_around.es: La forma más económica de moverse por la mayor parte de España es en autobús.
getting_around.quote: The least expensive way to get around most parts of Spain is by bus.

getting_around.en: ALSA is the largest bus company, with point-to-point routes across the country.
getting_around.es: ALSA es la mayor empresa de autobuses, con rutas punto a punto por todo el país.
getting_around.quote: Largest bus company with point to point routes across the country

getting_around.en: Renfe's website usually accepts foreign credit cards, but if not, try PayPal.
getting_around.es: El sitio web de Renfe suele aceptar tarjetas de crédito extranjeras, pero si no, prueba con PayPal.
getting_around.quote: Their website usually accepts foreign credit cards, but if not, try PayPal.

money.en: Spain uses the euro, and you should not expect anybody to accept other currencies.
money.es: España usa el euro, y no debes esperar que nadie acepte otras monedas.
money.quote: Do not expect anybody to accept currencies other than euros, or to be willing to exchange currency.

money.en: Credit and debit cards are widely accepted.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito y débito se aceptan ampliamente.
money.quote: Credit and debit cards are widely accepted.

money.en: ATMs are abundant but add a fee of about €2-7 (Feb 2023) on top of your bank's charges.
money.es: Los cajeros son abundantes, pero añaden una comisión de unos 2-7 € (feb. 2023) además de la de tu banco.
money.quote: There is a fee in addition to what your bank charges you of about €2-7 (Feb 2023), except with Unicaja Banco machines.

money.en: Tipping is not mandatory nor considered customary in Spain.
money.es: La propina no es obligatoria ni habitual en España.
money.quote: Tipping, or "propina" in Spanish is not mandatory nor considered customary in Spain.

money.en: In mid-range or splurge restaurants you can give 5-10% if you feel the service was exemplary.
money.es: En restaurantes de gama media o alta puedes dar un 5-10% si el servicio fue ejemplar.
money.quote: In the mid-range or splurge segment you can give 5-10% if you feel that the service was exemplary.

money.en: Most shops close in the afternoons around 13:30/14:00 and reopen around 16:30/17:00, and almost everywhere is closed on Sundays.
money.es: La mayoría de las tiendas cierran por la tarde hacia las 13:30/14:00 y reabren hacia las 16:30/17:00, y casi todo cierra los domingos.
money.quote: Most businesses (including most shops, but not restaurants) close in the afternoons around 13:30/14:00 and reopen for the evening around 16:30/17:00.

etiquette.en: Spaniards are widely regarded as welcoming and friendly.
etiquette.es: Los españoles tienen fama de ser acogedores y amables.
etiquette.quote: Generally speaking, Spaniards are widely regarded as welcoming and friendly.

etiquette.en: Passing unwarranted comments or criticisms about someone's family members is considered rude.
etiquette.es: Hacer comentarios o críticas injustificadas sobre los familiares de alguien se considera de mala educación.
etiquette.quote: Passing unwarranted comments and/or criticisms about someone's family members is considered rude.

etiquette.en: Religious festivals, Holy Week and Christmas are very important to Spaniards.
etiquette.es: Las fiestas religiosas, la Semana Santa y la Navidad son muy importantes para los españoles.
etiquette.quote: In particular, religious festivals, Holy Week (Easter), and Christmas are very important to Spaniards

etiquette.en: Spain is gay-friendly overall, and public displays of same-sex affection would not likely stir hostility.
etiquette.es: España es en general abierta con la comunidad LGBT, y las muestras públicas de afecto entre personas del mismo sexo probablemente no causen hostilidad.
etiquette.quote: public display of same-sex affection would not likely stir hostility

etiquette.en: Take care when mentioning the Franco dictatorship and the Civil War, which are a painful past.
etiquette.es: Hay que tener cuidado al mencionar la dictadura de Franco y la Guerra Civil, un pasado doloroso.
etiquette.quote: Take care when mentioning the fascist dictatorship of Francisco Franco

etiquette.en: In some parts of Spain it is illegal to be in the street wearing only a bikini or swimming shorts.
etiquette.es: En algunas partes de España es ilegal estar en la calle solo con bikini o bañador.
etiquette.quote: In some parts of Spain it’s illegal to be in the street wearing only a bikini or swimming shorts.

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi in bars and cafeterias is available to customers, and most hotels offer Wi-Fi at least in common areas.
connectivity.es: El wifi de bares y cafeterías es para clientes, y la mayoría de los hoteles ofrecen wifi al menos en zonas comunes.
connectivity.quote: Wi-Fi points in bars and cafeterias are available to customers, and most hotels offer Wi-Fi connections (at least in common areas) for their guests.

connectivity.en: Prepaid mobile phones can be bought without many formalities, though ID is usually required.
connectivity.es: Los móviles prepago se pueden comprar sin muchos trámites, aunque normalmente se pide identificación.
connectivity.quote: can be purchased without many formalities (ID is usually required)

connectivity.en: Topping up with a prepaid SIM does not work via the web or an ATM with foreign credit cards.
connectivity.es: Recargar una SIM de prepago por web o en cajero no funciona con tarjetas de crédito extranjeras.
connectivity.quote: recharging using the Web or an ATM does not work with foreign credit cards

connectivity.en: For supported unlocked phones, a local SIM or an eSIM is another alternative.
connectivity.es: Para móviles liberados compatibles, una SIM local o una eSIM es otra alternativa.
connectivity.quote: For supported unlocked phones, a local SIM or an eSIM is another alternative.

connectivity.en: EU-based mobile subscriptions should be able to use at least some bundled minutes, SMS and data in Spain at no extra cost.
connectivity.es: Una suscripción móvil de un operador de la UE debería poder usar al menos parte de los minutos, SMS y datos incluidos en España sin coste extra.
connectivity.quote: you should be able to use at least some of your bundled minutes, SMS, and data in Spain at no extra cost
